notes:
Resume where the pause stopped, and put the owed exercise in front

Pausing now records what was left on the clock, and resuming gives back
exactly that instead of restarting a whole interval. A meeting no longer
costs the twenty minutes already waited, nor hands you a reminder the
second you sit down. If the time given back would land in a quiet window
or on an excluded day, the clock is replanned instead.

The owed exercise stops being a line on the home card saying one is due
— a line is read and ignored — and becomes the break itself, drawn over
whichever tab is open, first movement and three answers included, for a
stand break, a mobility break or the eyes alike. BreakOverlay lives in
AppLayout, so it never covers an exercise already under way nor a screen
you are not signed in behind. The /alerte/:kind route draws nothing now:
it records what is owed and steps aside, leaving one presentation of a
break rather than two that drift apart.

It closes without answering and comes back on the next foreground; the
card keeps saying one is due. Pausing the day holds it too, and resuming
brings it back — nothing is lost because a meeting landed badly.

Also drops the .npmrc script-shell added earlier today: it fixed
`pnpm apk` under cmd.exe but broke every other script, `pnpm dev`
included, because bash is not on the PATH of a PowerShell session.
scripts/gradle.ts starts the wrapper the platform actually has, with no
shell at all.
